review_candidates.title: System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description: Type of Requisition: Regular Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: Secret Clearance Level Must Be Able To Obtain: Top Secret/SCI Public Trust/Other Required: None Job Family: IT Infrastructure and Operations Skills: Job Qualifications: Active Directory (AD), Application Migration, Linux, Microsoft Server Administration, System Migrations Certifications: None Experience: 8 + years of related experience US Citizenship Required: Yes Summary: Job Description: We are seeking a Systems Engineer to design, integrate, and deploy the enterprise infrastructure required to support the modernization and migration of mission-critical systems across Europe. This role requires a versatile engineer capable of engineering and supporting diverse environments across compute, virtualization, storage, Windows, and Linux platforms. The Systems Engineer will coordinate closely with network, cybersecurity, cloud, and application teams to ensure seamless service availability, capacity management, system integration, and security compliance throughout modernization and migration efforts. Core Role Responsibilities: Lead planning, design, and cutover strategies for multi-platform infrastructure, focusing on compute, storage, and virtualization platforms. Ensure service availability, data integrity, and security during complex physical and virtual migration events. Develop migration runbooks, validation plans, and contingency/rollback procedures. Coordinate with network and cybersecurity teams for seamless service integration and security boundary enforcement. Execute the installation, configuration, and maintenance of servers, enterprise storage, and hypervisors in both physical and virtual environments. Collaborates with stakeholders to understand business needs and requirements and provide appropriate infrastructure solutions. Manages and tests backup and recovery procedures to ensure data integrity and availability across Windows, Linux, and virtualized workloads. Maintains detailed documentation of system configurations, infrastructure topology, procedures, and changes. Creates reports on system performance, storage utilization, security incidents, and other key metrics. Coordinates with other IT teams to ensure coordinated delivery of IT services. Provides recommendations for system improvements based on analysis and industry best practices. Technical Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of hybrid data center infrastructure, particularly VMware vSphere/Broadcom virtualized environments, enterprise storage platforms (Dell, NetApp), and physical server hardware. Proficient with cross-platform enterprise system administration, including fundamental Linux OS management alongside core Windows services (Active Directory, DNS). Skilled in enterprise backup/restore architectures, disaster recovery replication, and high-availability clustering across diverse platforms. Understanding of dependent application requirements, storage I/O profiles, and inter-service network dependencies. Ability to apply DoW cybersecurity hardening standards (DISA STIGs, ACAS scanning) across multi-vendor environments (VMware, Linux, Windows, Dell/NetApp). Skilled in leveraging vendor-specific automation platforms and APIs (e.g., VMware PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform) to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention. Minimum Experience: Minimum 5+ years experience with Data Center Solutions, Data Center Engineering, and/or Data Center Migration. Certifications: Recommended Professional Certifications: The candidate must possess one or more of the following certifications in addition to maintaining DoW 8570 IAT Level II compliance (e.g., Security+ CE). VMWare VCP - Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV) (Highly Desired) Dell Technologies Proven Professional (Storage focus) or NetApp Certified Data Administrator (NCDA) CompTIA Linux+, Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS), or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate VMWare VCP - Cloud Foundation Administrator Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) TESA Accreditation Requirements A bachelor's degree plus 3 years of recent specialized experience, OR; An associate's degree plus 7 years of recent specialized experience, OR; A major certification (as defined and accepted by DOCPER) plus 7 years of recent specialized experience, OR; 11 years of recent specialized experience Location: On Customer Site US Citizenship Required Clearance: Secret Gdit Is Your Place: 401K with company match Comprehensive health and wellness packages Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications Cutting-edge technology you can learn from Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays #DefenseOCONUS #GDITPriority The likely salary range for this position is $136,000 - $184,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. Total compensation for international positions varies by tax, social security, and immigration statuses, as well as location. Generally, an international assignment may include allowances, premium uplifts, and/or relocation or transportation benefits, above base salary range noted. Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Travel Required: Less than 10% Telecommuting Options: Onsite Work Location: International Additional Work Locations: Total Rewards At GDIT: Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most. Our Identity Verification Process: As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes. About Our Work: We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development. Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at gdit.com/tc. Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

review_candidates.title: Platform Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: When you join EDF Trading, you’ll become part of a diverse international team of experts who challenge conventional ideas, test new approaches, and think outside the box. Energy markets evolve rapidly, so our team needs to remain agile, flexible, and ready to spot opportunities across all the markets we trade in power, gas, LNG, LPG, oil, and environmental products. EDF Group and our customers all over the world trust that their assets are managed by us in the most effective and efficient manner and are protected through expert risk management. Trading for over 20 years, it’s experience that makes us leaders in the field. Energy is what we do. Become part of the team and you will be offered a great range of benefits, which include (location dependent) hybrid working, a personal pension plan, private medical and dental insurance, bi-annual health assessments, corporate gym memberships, an electric car lease programme, childcare vouchers, a cycle-to-work scheme, season ticket loans, volunteering opportunities, and much more. Gender balance and inclusion are very high on the agenda at EDF Trading, so you will become part of an ever-diversifying family of around 750 colleagues based in London, Paris, Singapore, and Houston. Regular social and networking events, both physical and virtual, will ensure that you always feel connected to your colleagues and the business. Who are we? We are EDF Trading, part of the EDF Group - a world leader in low-carbon, sustainable electricity generation. Join us, make a difference, and help shape the future of energy. Department Information Technology Position Purpose Lead the Platform Operations function responsible for the reliable, secure and cost-effective operation of EDF Trading's core technology infrastructure. The role owns the operational lifecycle of compute, virtualisation, storage, backup, network services, operating systems, data centre infrastructure and core platform services. It is accountable for ensuring infrastructure services meet availability, performance, resilience and cybersecurity requirements while supporting the firm's engineering, trading, data and corporate technology platforms. The position drives automation, infrastructure-as-code adoption, operational simplification and technology lifecycle management, enabling Platform Engineering to provide stable foundations for application delivery, data platforms, AI workloads and business-critical services. Main Responsibilities Lead the Platform Operations team responsible for compute, virtualisation, storage, backup, network services, operating systems, patch management and core infrastructure platforms. Own operational performance, availability, capacity and resilience of infrastructure services across on-premise, co-located and cloud-hosted environments. Establish infrastructure standards, operational procedures and engineering practices that promote automation, repeatability and operational excellence. Drive adoption of Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management and infrastructure automation, reducing manual effort and operational risk. Manage infrastructure lifecycle, including hardware refresh, vendor supportability, patching and vulnerability remediation. Ensure robust backup, recovery, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities are designed, tested and maintained. Own infrastructure operational readiness, monitoring, capacity management and service reporting. Lead infrastructure-related major incidents, ensuring rapid recovery and implementation of long-term corrective actions. Manage supplier relationships for infrastructure technologies, data centres, connectivity providers and managed service partners. Establish cost transparency and optimisation initiatives across infrastructure services without compromising resilience or service quality. Collaborate closely with the other IT teams to provide integrated platform services. Build and develop a highly capable operational engineering function with a culture of ownership, automation and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities. Manage third-party suppliers, contracts, licensing and the Platform Operations budget. Build team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, succession planning and continuous learning. Experience Required Significant leadership experience managing enterprise infrastructure and operations teams within a complex, business-critical environment. Demonstrable ownership of large-scale infrastructure estates spanning cloud, private cloud and traditional infrastructure technologies. Experience supporting highly available trading, financial services or other mission-critical environments. Proven track record delivering infrastructure modernisation, automation and operational transformation programmes. Experience managing operational risk, resilience testing, incident management and disaster recovery activities. Strong supplier-management experience including major technology vendors, cloud providers and outsourced service partners. Technical Requirements Knowledge of Windows and Linux server platforms (both physical and virtual), including lifecycle, patching, hardening and operational support considerations. Experience with enterprise storage, backup and recovery services, supporting resilience, data protection and disaster recovery objectives. Strong network infrastructure capability, including Cisco technologies, secure connectivity, segmentation, routing, switching and monitoring. Understanding of Entra ID and identity services, including authentication, access control and hybrid identity integration. Advanced Azure knowledge, including hybrid integration with on-premise platforms, identity, networking, resilience and operational management. Knowledge of Kubernetes and container platforms used to support scalable and automated application delivery. Knowledge of Zscaler or equivalent cloud security platforms supporting secure connectivity, zero trust access and internet protection. Good understanding of IT security controls and tooling across vulnerability management, access control, monitoring, endpoint protection and incident response. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management, supporting automation, consistency, version control and controlled change. Familiarity with Citrix and end-user computing platforms supporting secure access and resilient desktop services. Person Specification Proven ability to lead, develop and motivate technical teams, setting clear expectations while building capability, accountability and a strong service culture. Sound judgement and structured problem-solving in complex operational environments. Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Calm, disciplined prioritisation under pressure, particularly during incidents or competing delivery demands. Business-aligned strategic thinking, connecting infrastructure choices to resilience, security, cost and service outcomes. Continuous improvement mindset, with a practical interest in automation, standardisation and emerging technologies. Hours of Work: 8.30am – 5.30pm / 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

review_candidates.title: Service Manager Network Services – International Defence (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Stellenbeschreibung Du bist Teil unseres stark wachsenden Unternehmensbereichs Defence & Intelligence am Standort Köln. Zu unserem Kundenstamm zählen neben großen Unternehmen aus dem Rhein‑Ruhr‑Gebiet auch internationale Auftraggeber und Kunden aus dem Verteidigungs‑ und Sicherheitsumfeld. Dies gibt dir die Möglichkeit, in unterschiedlichen Projekten, Teams und Konstellationen zu arbeiten sowie deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich anzuwenden und weiterzuentwickeln. Als Service Manager Network Services (m/w/d) verantwortest du die globale Steuerung der Network Operations mit einem klaren Schwerpunkt auf Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung moderner Multi‑Cloud‑Netzwerkarchitekturen. Du führst global verteilte Operations‑Teams und stellst sicher, dass Netzwerkservices stabil, leistungsfähig, sicher und regelkonform erbracht werden. Der Fokus der Rolle liegt sowohl auf der Leitung globaler Betriebseinheiten als auch auf der fachlichen Verantwortung für Netzwerkarchitekturen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Multi‑Cloud‑Transit, Netzwerk‑Segmentierung und Firewall‑Architekturen. Die Rolle erfordert ausdrücklich eigene fundierte technische Netzwerkerfahrung, um Architektur‑, Betriebs‑ und Eskalationsentscheidungen auf Augenhöhe bewerten zu können. Wenn du Freude an Verantwortung, an der Steuerung komplexer Service‑Landschaften und an der Arbeit im internationalen Defence‑Umfeld hast, bieten wir dir ein langfristig stabiles und professionelles Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Sichtbarkeit. Bei CGI fördern wir ein vielfältiges, partnerschaftliches und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld. Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder Lebensweg – insbesondere Frauen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen, ihre Perspektiven einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Aufgaben Als Service Manager Network (m/w/d) trägst du die End‑to‑End‑Verantwortung für Betrieb, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der globalen Network Operations innerhalb der Projekt‑ und Kundenumgebung. Der Arbeitsort kann flexibel gestaltet werden: in unserem CGI Office in Köln, remote aus Deutschland oder direkt beim Kunden – national wie international. Aufgrund der projekt- und kundennahen Aufgaben ist eine ausgeprägte Reisebereitschaft zwingend erforderlich. Deine Aufgaben: Gesamtverantwortung für die Steuerung und Führung global verteilter Network‑Operations‑Teams Sicherstellung eines stabilen, leistungsfähigen und regelkonformen Betriebs globaler Netzwerkservices Fachliche Verantwortung für das Design, die Weiterentwicklung und Governance von Multi‑Cloud‑Netzwerkarchitekturen, basierend auf eigener praktischer Netzwerkerfahrung Verantwortung für Multi‑Cloud‑Transit‑Konzepte, einschließlich der Anbindung von Hyperscalern, Rechenzentren und On‑Premises‑Infrastrukturen Design‑, Steuerungs‑ und Betriebsverantwortung für Netzwerk‑Segmentierungs‑Konzepte (z. B. Security Zoning, Zero‑Trust‑Ansätze, Micro‑Segmentation) Verantwortung für Firewall‑Architekturen (zentrale/dezentrale Modelle, cloud‑native Firewalls, hybride Security‑Gateways) Technische Bewertung von Architektur‑, Design‑ und Betriebsentscheidungen im Netzwerkumfeld Überwachung, Steuerung und Einhaltung der vereinbarten Service Level Agreements (SLAs) Bewertung der Servicequalität anhand von KPIs sowie Ableitung von Maßnahmen zur Stabilisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Steuerung und Koordination von Eskalationen und Major Incidents im Netzwerkumfeld Enge Abstimmung mit angrenzenden Bereichen wie Security, Cloud‑Plattform‑Teams, Infrastruktur‑Architektur und Service Management Steuerung externer Dienstleister sowie Technologie‑ und Netzwerkpartner Vorbereitung, Moderation und Nachbereitung von Service‑Reviews, Architektur‑Boards und Management‑Gremien Adressatengerechte Berichterstattung gegenüber Auftraggebern und Management Qualifikation Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Fach‑ oder Hochschulstudium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (Wirtschafts‑)Ingenieurwesen oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Alternativ bringst du eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung mit mehrjähriger relevanter Berufserfahrung im Netzwerk‑ bzw. Infrastrukturumfeld mit. Optimalerweise bringst Du bereits Erfahrung mit der Arbeit in sicherheitskritischen oder stark regulierten Projekten mit - idealerweise im Umfeld von Defence, Intelligence, öffentlichen Auftraggebern oder internationalen Sicherheitsorganisationen. Zu Deinen Kompetenzen zählen außerdem: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Service Management oder Service Delivery Management mit globaler Verantwortung Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung und Steuerung global verteilter Network‑Operations‑Teams Fundierte eigene technische Erfahrung im Netzwerkbetrieb und in Netzwerkarchitekturen, die eine fachliche Steuerung auf Augenhöhe mit Architekten, Betriebseinheiten und Providern ermöglicht Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Netzwerk‑ und Infrastrukturarchitekturen Tiefgehende Erfahrung im Design und Betrieb von Multi‑Cloud‑Netzwerken Expertise in Multi‑Cloud‑Transit‑Architekturen (z. B. Hub‑and‑Spoke‑Modelle, zentralisierte und dezentrale Transit‑Ansätze) Umfassende Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Netzwerk‑Segmentierungs‑ und Security‑Zonen‑Konzepten Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Firewall‑Architekturen (On‑Premises, Hybrid, Cloud‑native) Praktische Erfahrung mit gängigen Netzwerk‑ und Security‑Herstellern, insbesondere: Cisco, Fortinet, Genua, Palo Alto Networks, sowie vergleichbaren Enterprise‑Netzwerktechnologien Erfahrung in der Steuerung herstellerübergreifender Netzwerk‑Landschaften Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Incident‑, Problem‑ und Eskalationsmanagement, insbesondere bei kritischen Netzwerkstörungen Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im SLA‑Management sowie in der Nutzung von KPIs zur Steuerung globaler Betriebsleistungen Kenntnisse gängiger Service‑ und Governance‑Frameworks (z. B. ITIL) Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder‑Management, in strukturierter Kommunikation und in der Moderation technischer sowie Management‑Gremien Sehr gute Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Eine vorhandene oder die Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung (z. B. Ü2), abhängig vom Projekteinsatz Mögliche Zertifikate (wünschenswert): ITIL® 4 (Foundation oder höher) Netzwerk‑Zertifizierungen (z. B. Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Juniper) Cloud‑Netzwerk‑Zertifizierungen (z. B. AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer) ISO/IEC 27001 oder vergleichbare Security‑Zertifizierungen WAS WIR BIETEN: Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning-Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Wir bieten verschiedene Modelle, damit du mobil sein kannst: Bahncard, Dienstfahrrad oder Firmenwagen. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

review_candidates.title: IT Help Desk Specialist
review_candidates.description: FAR Networks è alla ricerca di un/una figura di IT Help Desk Specialist con circa 2 anni di esperienza nel supporto tecnico agli utenti e nella gestione delle postazioni di lavoro. La figura sarà inserita all'interno del team IT e avrà il compito di fornire supporto agli utenti aziendali nella gestione delle problematiche quotidiane relative a postazioni di lavoro, dispositivi mobili, applicazioni Microsoft 365 e strumenti aziendali. Cerchiamo una persona con un buon orientamento al servizio, capacità di problem solving e predisposizione al rapporto con gli utenti, in grado di gestire autonomamente le richieste più comuni e di effettuare escalation verso i livelli tecnici superiori quando necessario. Principali responsabilità La risorsa si occuperà principalmente di: Gestione delle richieste di assistenza attraverso piattaforme di ticketing , garantendo corretta classificazione, aggiornamento e tracciamento delle attività. Supporto tecnico di primo e secondo livello agli utenti, sia da remoto sia in presenza. Installazione, configurazione e manutenzione delle postazioni di lavoro Windows . Preparazione e configurazione di nuovi PC per l'onboarding degli utenti. Gestione delle problematiche relative a periferiche quali monitor, docking station, stampanti, cuffie e altri dispositivi. Configurazione e supporto di smartphone e tablet aziendali , principalmente dispositivi iOS e Android. Supporto agli utenti nell'utilizzo dei principali servizi Microsoft 365 , tra cui: Outlook ed Exchange Online; Microsoft Teams; OneDrive; SharePoint Online; applicazioni Microsoft Office. Gestione delle attività base relative agli account utente, come configurazione profili, reset password e verifica degli accessi. Supporto nelle attività di onboarding e offboarding degli utenti. Installazione, aggiornamento e troubleshooting delle applicazioni aziendali. Diagnosi delle problematiche di connettività di base relative a LAN, Wi-Fi e VPN. Applicazione delle procedure aziendali relative alla sicurezza delle postazioni di lavoro. Escalation delle problematiche più complesse verso i team sistemistici, networking, security o applicativi. Documentazione delle soluzioni e aggiornamento della knowledge base interna. Gestione dell'inventario e della corretta assegnazione dei dispositivi IT agli utenti. Requisiti Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Help Desk, Service Desk o IT Support . Buona conoscenza dei sistemi operativi Microsoft Windows 10/11 . Esperienza nella gestione e configurazione di PC e notebook. Conoscenza dei principali strumenti della suite Microsoft 365 . Esperienza nell'utilizzo di piattaforme di ticketing o Service Desk. Conoscenza della gestione di dispositivi mobili iOS e Android. Conoscenze di base relative a: networking TCP/IP; Wi-Fi; VPN; DNS e DHCP. Capacità di effettuare troubleshooting hardware e software. Familiarità con strumenti di assistenza remota. Buone capacità comunicative e predisposizione al rapporto con gli utenti. Capacità di organizzare e prioritizzare le richieste. Attitudine al problem solving e al lavoro in team. Competenze preferenziali Costituiranno titolo preferenziale: conoscenza di Microsoft Entra ID / Azure Active Directory ; esperienza con strumenti di Mobile Device Management / Endpoint Management , in particolare Microsoft Intune; conoscenza di Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; esperienza nella gestione di utenti e dispositivi attraverso Microsoft 365 Admin Center; conoscenza di Active Directory; esperienza con procedure strutturate di Incident Management e Request Fulfilment; conoscenza dei principi ITIL; esperienza nella gestione dell'inventario hardware e software. Soft skill Cerchiamo una persona: orientata al servizio e alla soddisfazione dell'utente; precisa e organizzata; capace di mantenere un approccio professionale anche nella gestione di utenti in difficoltà; curiosa e interessata ad approfondire nuove tecnologie; capace di lavorare in autonomia sulle attività quotidiane; disponibile alla collaborazione e alla condivisione delle conoscenze con il resto del team. Seniority La posizione è rivolta a un profilo Junior con indicativamente 2 anni di esperienza nel supporto IT agli utenti . Non è richiesta una competenza sistemistica specialistica: la figura dovrà essere autonoma nella gestione delle problematiche comuni degli utenti e delle postazioni di lavoro e in grado di riconoscere quando sia necessario coinvolgere livelli di supporto specialistici. Sede Cernusco sul Naviglio con disponibilità a trasferte Pay Trasparency La Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo parte da 25.000 euro lordi annui a cui si aggiunge il pacchetto benefits FAR. Questa cifra rappresenta il minimo del range retributivo previsto per la posizione. L’offerta economica potrà quindi crescere in base a diversi elementi, tra cui esperienza professionale maturata, competenze tecniche, percorso formativo, soft skills, attitudini e coerenza del profilo rispetto alle responsabilità e agli obiettivi del ruolo. In FAR Networks promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e valorizziamo la diversità. La ricerca è aperta a tutte le persone, indipendentemente da genere, origine etnica o razziale, religione e convinzioni personali.

review_candidates.description: 会社概要 BoostDraftは、契約書をはじめとする法的文書の作成・レビューを効率化するプロダクトを開発・提供するリーガルテック企業です。 2021年にMITとStanford大学院の卒業生が創業し、現在6年目を迎えています。創業以来黒字経営を続けており、2025年初頭までは完全自己資金で口コミを中心に成長してきました。現在は日本の5大法律事務所すべてを含む、国内外800社以上にご利用いただいており、韓国・シンガポール・米国・英国にも展開しています。 チームの約6割はソフトウェアエンジニアで、Microsoft、IBM、Yahoo!、NTT研究所などの出身者が在籍しています。 詳細はこちら: BoostDraft Company Deck このポジションについて BoostDraftは、大手企業や法律事務所のWord環境で動作するデスクトップアプリケーションです。導入先はセキュリティ要件の厳しいエンタープライズ環境が中心となり、プロキシ、セキュリティソフト、仮想環境（RDSH等）、社内ポリシーなど、お客様ごとに異なるIT環境でソフトウェアを確実に動かすことが、事業の生命線になっています。 このポジションは、その最前線に立つお客様の一次窓口です。導入時・利用時に発生する技術的なお問い合わせを受け止め、環境情報を聞き取り、原因の切り分けを行った上で、解決までをリードしていただきます。多くの案件はマニュアルとこれまでの対応履歴をもとにご自身で完結いただき、判断が難しい案件は開発チーム・ビジネスチームに相談しながら進めていただくことを想定しています。 扱うお問い合わせの例 インストールは完了したものの、Word上でBoostDraftのタブが表示されない 社内のプロキシやセキュリティソフトの影響で、通信がうまくいかない 仮想デスクトップ環境で利用したいが、どのように導入すればよいか分からない 導入にあたり、セキュリティチェックシートへの回答がほしい 想定業務 顧客環境での導入・動作トラブルの原因切り分けと解決（インストールエラー、アドイン不具合、プロキシ・ネットワーク起因の問題など） お客様（法務部門・情報システム部門）との直接のコミュニケーション（メール中心、必要に応じてオンラインミーティングや訪問） 開発チームとの連携（ログの収集・一次分析、再現条件の整理、調査依頼、修正版の顧客展開） セキュリティチェックシートへの対応 導入に伴う技術定型業務（設定入りインストーラの作成、アカウント登録、プロダクトキー発行など） 検証手順・対処法のナレッジ化と、顧客向け・IT部門向けマニュアルの継続的な更新 判断が難しい案件・重要度の高い案件の見極めと、社内へのエスカレーション （業務に慣れてきた後）顧客からのフィードバック・バグ報告の取りまとめと開発チームへの橋渡し この仕事の面白さ 相手は日本を代表する大手企業が中心です。日本のエンタープライズITの「現場のリアル」に深く触れることができます 自分の切り分け結果がそのままインストーラの改修や機能改善につながります。サポートで終わらず、プロダクトを変えられるポジションです チームの約半分以上がエンジニア。MicrosoftたNTT等の出身者を含む開発チームと日常的に連携しながら問題を解決に導きます マニュアルを渡されて終わりではありません。自分の対応した内容がそのままチームの標準になっていきます Requirements 必須の経験・スキル 法人のお客様に対する技術的な問い合わせ対応の実務経験1年以上（テクニカルサポート、ヘルプデスク、情報システム部門、SIerの運用保守など） Windows環境におけるトラブルシューティングの実務経験と、エンタープライズIT環境（レジストリ、プロキシ・ネットワーク設定、セキュリティソフト、Active Directoryなど）のいずれかに実務で触れた経験 社内外の関係者と信頼を構築できるコミュニケーション能力 日本語：ネイティブレベル / 英語：読み書きレベル（TOEIC換算600点程度が目安です。翻訳ツールの併用可、会話力は必須ではありません。） ※必要に応じて、お客様先への訪問が発生します。 歓迎する経験・スキル SaaS/BtoBソフトウェアプロダクト企業でのテクニカルサポート、カスタマーサクセス、Technical Account Manager、導入支援の経験 セキュリティチェックシートやIT統制関連の対応経験 Officeアドイン（COM/VSTO）、ClickOnceに関する知見 RDSH、Citrix、VDIなどの仮想デスクトップ環境の運用・サポート経験 PowerShellやバッチファイルの読解・作成経験 求める人物像 「再現しない」「環境依存」といった厄介な問題を、諦めずに切り分けきることに面白さを感じる方 相手の状況や前提を踏まえて、伝わる手順書・文章を書ける方 フルリモート環境で、指示や監督がなくとも自ら課題を見つけて動ける方 同じ問い合わせが二度発生しないように、仕組みや手順を整えることに面白さを感じる方 Benefits 働き方 フルリモート 東京近辺在住の従業員は月に複数回、対面業務が発生する可能性あり 必要に応じてお客様先への訪問が発生する場合があります フレックスタイム フレキシブルタイム: 午前6時〜午前11時半 / 午後3時〜午後10時 コアタイム: 午前11時半〜午後3時 バーチャルオフィス バーチャル空間で自身のキャラクターを作成し、他社員との交流や会議が可能 その他 ＜勤務地＞ 原則自宅、その他自宅に準じる場所 ※業務都合により会社が指定する場所への出社の可能性あり ＜休日＞ 完全週休二日制（土日祝日 / 年末年始(会社の定める日) / その他会社の定める日） ＜採用形態＞ 正社員・年俸制（固定残業代） ※期限の定めなし ＜試用期間の有無＞ 有り（6か月） ＜受動喫煙防止措置＞ 有り 他の詳細は面談内にてお伝えいたします。

review_candidates.title: Senior Executive Director
review_candidates.description: Requirements Master’s degree in social services, business, health administration, or related field. 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in behavioral health, healthcare, or human services. Experience leading multi-site or statewide operations. Experience managing executive-level staff and leadership teams. Demonstrated operational leadership, including process improvement, systems optimization, and improving efficiencies. Demonstrated experience leading program or system turnaround initiatives and driving measurable improvements. Experience with operational and financial performance management. Strong strategic planning, performance management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to partner effectively with clinical, operational, and executive leadership. Ability and willingness to travel regularly throughout Louisiana. The Behavioral Health Executive Director will provide statewide operational and strategic leadership for Adult Behavioral Health programs across Louisiana, leading managers and ensuring high-quality, recovery-oriented services. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, the Executive Director will have overall accountability for operational and financial performance, while providing hands-on leadership in process improvement, systems optimization, and operational efficiency. The role will be expected to assess complex operational challenges, identify gaps, improve processes and systems, and implement sustainable solutions that drive measurable results. The Executive Director will also provide statewide strategy and leadership for program and system turnaround, including evaluating underperforming programs, developing and executing improvement strategies, and driving improvements in program performance, quality, financial performance, and service delivery. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated experience leading statewide or multi-site operations, managing executive-level staff, improving operational processes and systems, and successfully leading program or organizational turnaround efforts. Regular travel throughout Louisiana is required. This position is based in Louisiana and will oversee all Adult Behavioral Health programs across the state. Regular travel throughout Louisiana is required. Benefits Merakey offers generous benefits that promote well-being, financial security, and work-life balance, including: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to healthcare advocacy support. Retirement plan -- both pre-tax and Roth (after-tax) options available for employee contributions. DailyPay -- access your pay when you need it! On the Goga well-being platform, featuring self-care tools and resources. Access Care.com for backup childcare, elder care, and household services. Confidential counseling, legal, and financial services through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Tuition reimbursement and educational partnerships. Employee discounts and savings programs on entertainment, travel, and lifestyle. Access to Pryor Online Learning for free online personal development classes. Learn more about our full benefits package - https://www.merakey.org/careers/benefits About Merakey Merakey is a non-profit provider of developmental, behavioral health, and education services. More than 8,000 employees provide support to nearly 40,000 individuals and families throughout 12 states across the country each year. Click here to watch a video about Merakey. Merakey strictly follows a zero-tolerance policy for abuse. Merakey is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer! We deeply value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnic background, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or disability status. Moreover, we are committed to creating teams that reflect the diversity of the communities we serve and encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. Merakey welcomes all Veterans to apply!

review_candidates.title: Projects Oriented Manager -Finance
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Project Manager with a CPA background who will be responsible for leading project-based initiatives and managerial assignments across the Finance function . The role combines significant financial reporting responsibilities with broad exposure to cross-functional activities, providing an excellent opportunity to gain diverse business experience and develop toward future leadership positions within the organization. This position is ideal for agile, high-potential candidates with a long-term perspective who are looking to build a meaningful career path and grow professionally within the company. Main Tasks: Initial Position – Acting Manager of the Chartering & Administration Procurement Department Chartering Payments & Accounts Management Oversee chartering-related payments and account balances, ensuring accuracy, timely execution, and proper approvals. Monitor vessel owners’ and charterers’ accounts, cash flow forecasts, and key control reports. Support financial closing activities and maintain compliance with internal controls and SOX requirements. HO Suppliers & Administration Payments & Accounts Management Manage HO suppliers’ and administration-related payments, ensuring timely processing and accurate accounting. Oversee VAT and tax reporting processes, including ongoing controls and regulatory compliance. Support quarterly and annual closing activities, provisions management, and SOX compliance. Equipment Quarterly & Annual Financial Statements Management Lead the preparation and review of quarterly and annual Equipment-related financial reports and balance sheet accounts. Analyze variances, manage accruals and provisions, and ensure the accuracy of financial statements. Maintain strong financial controls and ensure compliance with SOX and reporting requirements. Following Position – Potential areas of responsibility: Following the acting assignment, the role is expected to evolve into a broader Finance leadership position, providing support across multiple Finance units based on business priorities, organizational needs, and strategic initiatives. Potential areas of responsibility include: Leading and supporting cross-functional Finance projects across the Finance functions, according to business needs and workload requirements. Financial reporting – Merger-related assignments, financial strategic projects and ad-hoc executive deliverables, as well as supporting interfaces within the Finance functions and with parties in other functions. Financial Data / Applications – Supporting reporting, analytics, data governance, and Finance data management initiatives. SAP S/4HANA Implementation - Supporting SAP S/4HANA implementation and related Finance systems enhancement projects. Participating in Cyber Security and Business Continuity initiatives to strengthen Finance operational resilience and readiness. Providing interim leadership and project support to Finance departments experiencing temporary resource constraints, organizational changes, or increased workload. Driving special assignments and executive-level projects, while serving as a flexible Finance resource capable of integrating quickly into different functions and contributing where needed most. Requirements: CPA (IL), following internship at one of the BIG4 firms. Preference to those with experience in Audit teams handling global / large-scale / publicly traded corporates. Up to 2 years of Managerial experience – At the accounting firms, or at a ‘first’ position following the internship (outside the accounting firms). Adequate English to maintain frequent written (and sometime verbal) communication.

review_candidates.title: MDM Application Engineer (Stibo STEP)
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. MDM Application Engineer (Stibo STEP) Location: DMESS, Abu Dhabi, UAE Department: Data & AI Employment Type: Full-Time Shape the Future of Master Data at Damen At Damen Shipyards Group, we are on an ambitious journey to become a truly data-powered organization. To support this vision, we are strengthening our Data & AI capabilities and investing in the people, platforms, governance, and technologies that enable trusted, high-quality data across the enterprise. The role is intended to strengthen Damen's Master Data Management capability and ensure that master data becomes a reliable foundation for operational excellence, analytics, AI, and digital transformation initiatives. We are not looking for someone who simply administers an application. We are looking for a hands-on MDM professional who understands how master data drives business value and who can help evolve our enterprise data landscape through robust platform engineering, process improvement, and stakeholder collaboration. You may come from manufacturing, shipbuilding, construction, marine, offshore, engineering, energy, utilities, or similar asset-intensive industries where fragmented data, disconnected systems, and inconsistent data definitions create operational challenges. This is an opportunity to influence how trusted master data is managed across a global maritime leader and contribute directly to Damen's Data & AI transformation journey. The Role As an MDM Application Engineer (Stibo STEP), you will be responsible for the configuration, development, support, and continuous improvement of Damen's Master Data Management platform. You will work closely with Data Owners, Data Stewards, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to establish scalable master data capabilities that improve data quality, governance, standardization, and business performance. The role requires a balance between technical expertise, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, operational support, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Develop & Enhance the MDM Platform Configure and maintain Stibo STEP workflows, business rules, validations, and data models Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable MDM solutions Develop enhancements that improve data quality, process efficiency, and user experience Support the onboarding of new master data domains and data management capabilities Ensure platform configurations align with enterprise architecture and governance standards Support Business-Critical Operations Investigate and resolve incidents, defects, and service requests Monitor platform performance, stability, and reliability Provide application support and technical guidance to business stakeholders Manage operational activities through established service management processes Maintain technical documentation and knowledge repositories Enable Enterprise Data Quality & Integration Design, develop, and support integrations between Stibo STEP and enterprise platforms Ensure master data consistency across multiple systems and business domains Collaborate with integration teams to maintain secure and reliable data flows Support enterprise-wide data quality initiatives Contribute to the implementation of data stewardship and governance practices Collaborate & Drive Continuous Improvement Work with Product Owners, Data Architects, and business stakeholders to prioritize improvements Participate in Agile delivery processes and sprint activities Collaborate with external implementation partners and technology vendors Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and simplification Promote best practices in Master Data Management across the organization Experience What We're Looking For Minimum 5 years of experience in Application Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Master Data Management, or related disciplines Hands-on experience with Stibo Systems STEP or comparable MDM platforms Proven experience configuring, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise applications Experience working with business-critical systems in complex organizations Experience working within Agile delivery environments Experience supporting global stakeholders across multiple business functions Technical Expertise Stibo Systems STEP Master Data Management (MDM) Data Governance Data Quality Management JavaScript REST APIs JSON & XML Workflow Configuration & Automation Enterprise Systems Integration Azure DevOps ServiceNow Data Modelling Fundamentals Personal Attributes Analytical and structured thinker Strong problem-solving capabilities Customer-focused and service-oriented Excellent stakeholder management skills Strong communication and collaboration abilities Pragmatic, hands-on, and outcome-oriented Comfortable working in evolving and fast-paced environments Passionate about data quality, governance, and continuous improvement Why Join Damen? At Damen, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact by helping establish trusted data foundations that support business operations, digital transformation, analytics, and AI initiatives across a global maritime leader. You will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders across multiple countries, functions, and business units while working with one of the organization's key enterprise data platforms. As part of a growing Data & AI function, you will benefit from strong executive sponsorship, strategic investment, and the opportunity to contribute directly to Damen's long-term data maturity ambitions. This is a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise, business engagement, and innovation while working in a collaborative environment that encourages ownership, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is currently working as an MDM Engineer, MDM Application Engineer, Stibo STEP Consultant, Product Information Management Consultant, Application Engineer, Enterprise Application Specialist, Master Data Specialist, or similar role within a complex industrial organization and has experience implementing, supporting, and improving enterprise master data capabilities. This individual combines technical expertise, business understanding, and stakeholder collaboration skills to deliver reliable solutions that improve how master data is managed across the enterprise.

review_candidates.title: Senior Executive Assistant
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a highly professional and experienced Senior Executive Assistant to work directly with the Director of Content & Production at a television and film production company. This is not a traditional secretarial role. It is a senior executive support position requiring a highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented professional who can independently manage schedules, correspondence, travel, research, translation, executive follow-ups, and day-to-day priorities. Professional and practical use of AI tools is an important part of the role. This is a full-time remote position, with priority given to candidates based in Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria. Responsibilities Manage the executive calendar, meetings, reminders, appointments, and daily priorities. Proactively identify and resolve scheduling conflicts and reorganize the calendar when necessary. Monitor and prioritize email correspondence and draft professional responses in both Arabic and English. Track tasks, decisions, deadlines, and pending follow-ups with content and production teams and external parties. Conduct detailed online research, verify information, and prepare clear executive summaries and reports. Translate correspondence, documents, reports, and business communications between Arabic and English. Arrange flights, hotels, transportation, and complete travel itineraries. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action items, follow-up trackers, reports, presentations, and administrative documents. Organize digital files and maintain accurate document management systems. Handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion. Use AI tools for research, translation, summarization, professional correspondence, document preparation, and workflow organization. Provide proactive executive support without requiring detailed instructions for every task. Coordinate with internal teams, external partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders when required. Travel within or outside Egypt when necessary, with advance notice. Core Requirements Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in executive assistance, office management, executive coordination, or a similar senior support role. Previous experience working directly with a CEO, Chairman, General Manager, Department Director, senior executive, or public figure. Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English. Ability to independently draft and respond to professional business correspondence in English. Excellent written and professional communication skills in Arabic. Strong experience managing executive calendars, meetings, email, reminders, bookings, travel, and follow-ups. Practical, hands-on experience using AI tools in daily professional work. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, online meeting platforms, and cloud-based file management. Strong research, fact-checking, summarization, and information-verification skills. Excellent time management, prioritization, and multitasking abilities. High attention to detail, accuracy, discretion, and professionalism. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to anticipate executive needs. Ability to work independently and respond quickly in a fast-paced remote environment. Access to a suitable computer/laptop, stable internet connection, and an appropriate remote workspace. Preferred Qualifications Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience in: Television or film production. Content creation or media production. Media, advertising, or public relations companies. Executive offices within large or multinational organizations. Project coordination or production coordination. Travel management. Supporting senior executives or high-profile individuals. Nature of the Role Full-time. Remote. Requires flexibility and quick responsiveness within a daily working window of up to 12 hours, depending on the operational needs of the Content & Production department. Any approved overtime will be compensated separately. Occasional travel within or outside Egypt may be required with advance notice. Compensation Monthly compensation ranges from USD 700 to USD 1,000, depending on: Relevant experience. English proficiency. Professional capabilities. Performance in the practical hiring assessments.

review_candidates.description: Hellenic Wineries Group Ο Όμιλος Ελληνικά Οινοποιεία , ένας από τους δυναμικά αναπτυσσόμενους ομίλους στον κλάδο του κρασιού στην Ελλάδα, αναζητά έναν IT Support & ERP Specialist για να ενταχθεί στην ομάδα μας. Η θέση έχει ως βασικό αντικείμενο την καθημερινή υποστήριξη του πληροφοριακού περιβάλλοντος του Ομίλου , την άμεση εξυπηρέτηση των χρηστών και την αποτελεσματική διαχείριση θεμάτων που αφορούν τα IT συστήματα και το ERP. Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες Παροχή καθημερινής IT υποστήριξης στους χρήστες του Ομίλου και επίλυση τεχνικών προβλημάτων. Υποστήριξη σε θέματα hardware, software, Windows, Microsoft 365, email, printers, connectivity και network . Εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και συντήρηση υπολογιστών και περιφερειακών συσκευών. Διαχείριση χρηστών, δικαιωμάτων πρόσβασης και βασικών IT διαδικασιών. Παρακολούθηση και συντονισμός τεχνικών θεμάτων με εξωτερικούς IT συνεργάτες και προμηθευτές. Υποστήριξη του ERP Entersoft και των χρηστών σε καθημερινά λειτουργικά ζητήματα. Συνεργασία με την Entersoft και τους εξωτερικούς ERP consultants για την καταγραφή, διερεύνηση και επίλυση θεμάτων. Παρακολούθηση ERP requests, incidents και απαιτούμενων ενεργειών μέχρι την οριστική επίλυσή τους. Συμμετοχή σε ERP improvements, upgrades, implementations και λοιπά IT projects του Ομίλου. Συνεργασία με τα διαφορετικά τμήματα της εταιρείας για την ομαλή και αποτελεσματική λειτουργία των πληροφοριακών συστημάτων. Απαραίτητα Προσόντα Πτυχίο ΑΕΙ/ΤΕΙ σε Πληροφορική, Computer Science ή συναφή κλάδο θα θεωρηθεί επιπλέον προσόν. 2–4 έτη επαγγελματικής εμπειρίας σε IT Support, IT Administration ή αντίστοιχη θέση. Πολύ καλή γνώση περιβάλλοντος Microsoft Windows & Microsoft 365 . Καλή γνώση βασικών αρχών networking, hardware και troubleshooting . Εμπειρία στην υποστήριξη χρηστών σε εταιρικό περιβάλλον. Εμπειρία σε ERP περιβάλλον . Εμπειρία σε Entersoft ERP θα θεωρηθεί σημαντικό πλεονέκτημα. Καλή γνώση της Αγγλικής γλώσσας. Πολύ καλή επικοινωνία και συνεργατικότητα. Αναλυτική σκέψη και αποτελεσματική επίλυση προβλημάτων. Οργάνωση, συνέπεια και προσανατολισμός στην εξυπηρέτηση του εσωτερικού πελάτη. Hands-on προσέγγιση και διάθεση ανάληψης πρωτοβουλιών. Η θέση απαιτεί Έναν επαγγελματία που μπορεί να λειτουργεί ως σημείο αναφοράς για τα καθημερινά IT θέματα , να κατανοεί τις ανάγκες των χρηστών και της επιχείρησης και να μετατρέπει τα προβλήματα σε πρακτικές και αποτελεσματικές λύσεις. Η εξοικείωση με το Entersoft ERP είναι ιδιαίτερα σημαντική, καθώς ο ρόλος θα έχει ενεργή συμμετοχή στην καθημερινή λειτουργία του ERP και στην επικοινωνία με την Entersoft για την επίλυση και βελτίωση των σχετικών διαδικασιών. Τι προσφέρουμε Ένταξη σε έναν δυναμικά αναπτυσσόμενο Όμιλο με παρουσία στον χώρο του κρασιού. Σταθερό και επαγγελματικό εργασιακό περιβάλλον. Συνεργασία με έμπειρους επαγγελματίες και εξωτερικούς technology partners. Δυνατότητα συμμετοχής σε ERP και IT projects με άμεσο αντίκτυπο στην καθημερινή λειτουργία της εταιρείας. Ευκαιρίες επαγγελματικής ανάπτυξης και διεύρυνσης γνώσεων. Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών, ανάλογο της εμπειρίας και των προσόντων. 📍 Location: Αθήνα

These attitudes and beliefs shall guide our actions and relationships. Role and responsibilities The purpose of the Consortium Coordinator is to support the EU Agri-TVET Consortium manager. This support will focus on project management, as well as strengthening the synergies, collaboration and engagement between NRC and the other Consortium partners. Furthermore, the Coordinator will strengthen the relationships and coordination between the Consortium and external partners, Clusters/WGs and other relevant stakeholders. The following is a brief description of the role. Generic responsibilities Adherence to NRC policies, tools, handbooks and guidelines Implement delegated EU Agri-TVET Consortium portfolio according to the plan of action Conduct quality control and provide technical support to implementing partners and/or contactors Contribute to the coordination of implementation of the Consortium work plan (activities, budget and project documentation) in line with proposals, strategies and donor requirements Provide specific technical support and capacity building towards EU Agri-TVET Consortium partners and staff Assess, promote and document ideas for technical improvement and further program development options Prepare and develop status reports as required by management Coordinate between all parties under the Consortium Ensure proper filing of documents Specific responsibilities Support the development and implementation of Consortium Strategy in line with evolving needs, operational context and technical practices Promote adherence to the common rationale and harmonized tools and guidelines Contribute to the coordination and operational issues amongst EU Agri-TVET partners. Support constructive and structured communication, engagement and coordination between various stakeholders Contribute to the development of new programme proposals and drafting of reports Represent the Consortium in coordination forums; and attend internal and external meetings, when requested by the Head of EU Agri-TVET Consortium Ensure compliance with donor guidelines/rules/regulations and contractual obligations Deputize for the Head of Agri-TVET Consortium in his/her absence Critical interfaces By interfaces, NRC means processes and projects that are interlinked with other departments/units or persons. Relevant interfaces for this position are: Consortium Management Unit Programme Unit Head of Programmes Support functions Scale and scope of position Staff: N/A Stakeholders: Consortium Members (international and national), Consortium Steering Committee, Donors (EU etc.), Government Departments and UN agencies as relevant Budgets: N/A Information: Consortium Database and Online Platform Competencies Competencies are important for the employee and the organization to deliver desired results. They are relevant for all staff and are divided into the following two categories: Professional competencies These are skills, knowledge and experience that are important for effective performance. Generic professional competencies: Relevant university degree or higher education preferable in social studies Minimum 5 years of experience in programmatic implementation in a humanitarian/recovery context in South Sudan Experience working in complex and volatile contexts Experience working with refugees, IDPs or returnees Fluency in English, both written and verbal Context/ Specific skills, knowledge and experience: Technical experience in multisectoral response Technical experience in Education Programming including TVET Technical experience in Cash and Market-Based Interventions Experience in emergency response, including preparedness and response Experience in capacity building Strong safe programming/protection mainstreaming background Knowledge of EU reporting requirements is a plus 2. Behavioral competencies These are personal qualities that influence how successful people are in their job. NRC’s Competency Framework states 12 behavioral competencies and the following are essential for this position: Handling insecure environments Strategic thinking and strong analysis Empowering and building trust Influencing Initiating action and change Managing resources to optimize results 3.Performance Management The employee will be accountable for the responsibilities and the competencies, in accordance with the NRC Performance Management Manual. The following documents will be used for performance reviews: The Job Description The Work and Development Plan The Mid-term/End-of-trial Period Performance Review Template The End-term Performance Review Template The NRC Competency Framework

review_candidates.title: Specialist - People Experience & Culture
review_candidates.description: INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. What You'll Be Doing The People Experience & Culture Specialist leads the localisation and activation of the Group’s culture, employee experience, engagement, and wellbeing agenda in Egypt. Working closely with the Egypt leadership team, People Partners, and Group People Experience & Culture, the role translates Group priorities and employee insights into relevant country-level strategies and interventions. It provides specialist expertise to leaders, shapes key moments across the employee journey, and leads initiatives that strengthen engagement, inclusion, wellbeing, and the overall workplace experience. The role also positions Egypt as a test-and-learn market by designing and piloting new approaches, measuring their impact, and sharing insights and effective practices with the wider Group. What You’ll Need To Succeed Country People Experience and Culture Strategy Co-create and drive the Egypt People Experience & Culture roadmap with the country leadership team, ensuring alignment with Group priorities and local business and workforce needs. Translate employee and business insights into targeted priorities, interventions, and action plans. Partner with leaders to strengthen team cultures and embed inclusive, engaging, and healthy ways of working. Monitor the progress and impact of the country roadmap, identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement. Culture Activation and Change Lead the country activation and embedding of the Group’s culture principles and behaviours, adapting initiatives to ensure local relevance while maintaining their intended purpose. Design and facilitate culture interventions, including bootcamps, culture labs, hackathons, leadership sessions, and co-creation forums. Partner with leaders and People Partners to diagnose and address culture priorities at country, business-unit, and team levels. Build accountability and advocacy for culture across leadership teams, employee communities, and local champions. Design and deliver people centred change and communication campaigns that build understanding, participation, and sustained behaviour change. Mobilise People Experience & Culture communities and employee champions to strengthen bottom-up ownership of the workplace experience. Employee Listening, Engagement and Wellbeing Lead the Voice of People survey and other employee-listening activities in Egypt, including pulse checks, interviews, focus groups, and workshops. Partner with leaders and People Partners to interpret findings, identify priority areas, and translate insights into measurable action plans. Lead the Great Place to Work certification process in Egypt, coordinating stakeholders, communications, submissions, and follow-up actions. Design and deliver engagement and wellbeing initiatives that respond to employee needs and support a healthy, inclusive, and connected workplace. Facilitate employee forums, town halls, listening sessions, and events that promote dialogue, transparency, and connection. Support internal and external storytelling that strengthens employee engagement and showcases the workplace experience in Egypt. Employee Journey And Experience Design Lead employee journey mapping exercises across priority stages of the employee lifecycle to identify experience gaps and improvement opportunities. Partner with business units and People Partners to conduct employee experience diagnostics using quantitative and qualitative research methods. Facilitate design thinking and co-creation workshops to redesign priority experiences from an employee centred perspective. Localise and deploy Group employee experience products and solutions, including onboarding, internal mobility, flexible working, and other priority touchpoints. Design and pilot new employee experience interventions in Egypt, evaluate their effectiveness, and recommend opportunities for wider implementation. Insights, Analytics and Impact Consolidate and analyse employee experience, culture, engagement, and wellbeing data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Develop reports, dashboards, and executive presentations that translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations for leaders and the People & Culture community. Establish relevant success measures for initiatives and evaluate their reach, effectiveness, adoption, and employee impact. Integrate insights from different listening channels to provide a holistic view of the employee experience in Egypt. Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Partnership Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, People Partners, and key stakeholders to understand priorities and elevate culture and employee experience across Egypt. Act as a trusted advisor on culture, employee experience, engagement, and wellbeing, offering insight-led recommendations and constructively challenging leaders where needed. Partner with leaders to diagnose needs, co-create relevant interventions, and translate priorities into sustainable action. Connect country and Group stakeholders to strengthen alignment, share effective practices, and maintain collective ownership of outcomes What We Can Offer You With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. Using GenAI in Your Application Process To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. We Invite All Applicants to Apply It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

review_candidates.title: Senior Project Planner
review_candidates.description: About Us Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. At Worley, we’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and can thrive is essential to our mission of delivering sustainable change. We know that diverse and inclusive cultures are safer and more innovative. We encourage applications from candidates from all backgrounds and diversity characteristics and warmly encourage disabled or neurodivergent candidates to apply. Responsibilities Manage and coordinate planning and scheduling interfaces between the Client, PMT, Worley Project Controls team, engineering teams, and multiple contractors supporting the Integrated PDH-PP Plants project. Work closely with the Client and Worley Project Controls teams to ensure effective planning, scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, and reporting across all project phases. Review contractor and consultant baseline schedules, periodic updates, look-ahead schedules, forecasts, mitigation plans, and recovery programmes to ensure alignment with the project execution strategy, contractual requirements, and key milestones. Manage, maintain, and update the Level 1 Client Master Schedule, consolidating contractor schedules and ensuring that key interfaces, dependencies, and milestones are properly reflected. Monitor and assess overall project progress and performance across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and other project workstreams. Review and challenge contractor progress data, forecasts, and projected completion dates, including earned value and schedule performance analysis against approved baselines and project targets. Identify schedule risks, critical and near-critical path activities, constraints, delays, and interface issues, and recommend appropriate mitigation, corrective, and recovery actions. Prepare and consolidate weekly and monthly progress and performance reports, including schedule forecasts, trends, and key planning information for the Client, PMT, and project leadership. Support the validation of contractor progress, including progress measurement, reported quantities, and, where required, the review of progress claims and payment applications. Participate in planning, progress, schedule review, and coordination meetings, while ensuring that planning and reporting activities remain consistent with project procedures, contractual requirements, Client requirements, and Worley standards. Support the review and analysis of contractor Extension of Time (EOT) requests and claims and provide planning input to the PMT and Client for evaluation and resolution. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. Experienced in planning, scheduling, and project controls, preferably within oil & gas, petrochemical, refining, industrial, infrastructure sectors or downstream projects. Proven experience working in a PMC, PMT, EPC, or major capital project environment across Pre-FEED, FEED, and EPC phases. Strong proficiency in Primavera P6, including development, review, and analysis of baseline schedules, updates, look-ahead schedules, recovery programmes, and critical path analysis. Good knowledge of project controls principles, including progress measurement, earned value management, forecasting, schedule performance analysis, and reporting. Experience reviewing and challenging contractor schedules, progress updates, forecasts, and recovery plans across multiple contractors and work packages. Experience in delay analysis, Extension of Time (EOT) assessment, and schedule-related claims evaluation would be advantageous. Strong understanding of engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and interface management activities within large-scale industrial projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project reporting tools; experience with EcoSys and Power BI would be advantageous. Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with Client, PMT, Worley, and contractor teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Previous experience working in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East would be advantageous. PMP, PMI-SP, AACE or an equivalent professional certification would be advantageous. Moving forward together We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
